a.text: ♪May the vast lands they keep owre kynge.
♪His people, and alle his well-wyllynge,
♪And give them grace wythoute endyng!
♪Then may we call and savely syng,
♪Victoria, yeve thankes for owre hom!

options: You've been humming that song ever since we stepped into the throne room.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: 'Like' is too strong a word. It's just left an impression on me.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: My foster parents would hum it by my bedside whenever I couldn't sleep.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: I thought it was a lullaby. It's only long after they've passed on that I realized whom I was to them, who was their 'kynge'.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: The song became a stranger from that day forth, but the tune has remained familiar. I would never forget it.

options: Do you still remember him? The...

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: The King? I'm not familiar with him. As for the man who is my closest blood relative...

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: I won't lie, Doctor, I tried to piece together an image of my father in my memory.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: But when I saw him again with my own eyes, there was nothing familiar about him.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: He was a king, and I'm just a gangster from the streets. We have nothing in common, save for the name Victoria.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: There are more important things for me to think about.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: You heard the dukes talking. They're ready to abandon Londinium... my home, to whatever fate.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: This wasn't what I expected when Dr. Kal'tsit got you out of Chernobog and got me to plan a return to Victoria.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: But I've come too far to let it go.

options: I can't let go of the Rhodes Islanders, either.
The dukes know you can't let go of the people who need you. They're counting on it.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: And we're counting on them being obsessed with maintaining their own power.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: As long as their pride still needs the name 'Victoria', the city will have time to recover.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: It's a deal where the outcome is predetermined, and both sides of the table know that.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: It's the people who have had my back through all this that keeps me going.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: We're home. The war is over. It's time to listen to their voices.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: What is it, Doctor?

options: Perhaps the day will come when Rhodes Island doesn't approve of the choices you make.
Perhaps the day will come when you don't approve of the choices Rhodes Island makes.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: ...I know.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Many of us find it hard to accept that you assisted Wiš'adel with the evacuation of the remaining Sarkaz.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: But this war can go on no longer. I... We've lost enough people.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: And we've heard Sarkaz warning, loud and clear.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: The ducal fleets held their positions during the retreat because they all got the news—

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Massive Catastrophe clouds forming over the capitals of most of the Core countries almost simultaneously.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Talk about straightforward. They strolled back to Kazdel in broad daylight.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: You and Dr. Kal'tsit know what they could do with that piece of Originium.

options: They won't abuse it, unless their back is to the wall.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: For self-defense only? Maybe they think that way, for now.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: But there is no such thing as a guarantee when one is in possession of power far greater than one can control.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: I've seen many gangs rise rapidly with the backing of the nobility, only to fall apart from the inside just as quickly.

options: That's why Amiya is going back to Kazdel with them.
Amiya will keep the Originium under our oversight.

a.text: But you're not in a position to determine Sarkaz's destiny either. Both sides have been inflicted wounds that will not heal so easily.
The young Sarkaz regent has gotten his wish. The Sarkaz are once again united by concrete hatred, and obtained an Originium shard that belongs to them...
Hatred always ends the same way. Where will you be when that time comes?

steps.text: A golden lion walks out from behind the darkened throne and crouches by its side.
Gawain. It is like he was always here, like the reliefs around him, bearing witness to the Empire's rise and fall, all in the blink of an eye.
And now, his dark eyes have witnessed you.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Teacher?!

options: This is the first time you've shown yourself before me.

a.text: No need to fear. I am neither a monster nor an illusion.
I show myself now because I must.
Vina has chosen a path that she had not even considered, until now. She must grow, and you are in a position to help her.

options: Rhodes Island is already assisting her work in Londinium.

a.text: That is not what I mean. I have no intention to interfere in Victoria's destiny, whatever it may be.
But you have led her towards a confrontation with the destiny of Terra itself, on which hope is hard to come by.
I promised one who is long gone to walk with her until the very last, but now, even my own being is no longer a certainty—

options: We will try not to drag others into it.

a.text: I know Vina. When the day comes, she will stand with Rhodes Island, and you will need her. But where will you stand when that day comes?
There is no need to answer. She will witness on my behalf.
You are neither her follower, nor mentor, nor foe.
You already realize that the ties you share are one-of-a-kind.
Perhaps we can afford to wait for a chance at a fresh start. But Vina cannot.
I have taught you how to survive, Vina. But I cannot teach you how to become hope—
The one before you, however, can.

options: I know what I must do.

a.text: Then guide her, the one whom Vina trusts. You are the spark that lights her fire, the spring that drives her forward.
Listen to this one, Vina, when you find yourself in doubt.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: What is this instrument, Vina?

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: An engineering sample made by Rockrock. Says it keeps tired workers from growing drowsy. But how's that different from just taking a nap?

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Does it work?
Vina yawns, rubs her eyes, and continues to peruse the documents before her.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: What DOES wake you up, though, is responding to some forty petitions to eliminate the traitor, Millscar.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Have the citizens fighting over this outside calmed down?

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Yes. Horn brought a bunch of city guard's newcomers straight out of training camp.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Thank goodness it didn't get out of hand.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: It helped that the soldiers had families and comrades on both sides. *sigh* I really don't know what the people who still support Millscar are thinking.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: No surprise. It was Parliament that went back on its word first. We did have trouble with our medicine supply, and her stuff gave people hope.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Only false hope, though.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: At first, I thought you sent the Defense Forces to...

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Crack down? Using violence to suppress innocent countrymen is the most cowardly and least effective method—

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Why are you looking at me like that?

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Just feeling dumb for worrying at all.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Don't tease me. I've got a long way to go before I'm used to this role. Thank goodness I have a lot help from people I can trust.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: My teacher, the Doctor, and you... and many others.
She stretches, puts down Rockrock's sample, and lets out a long exhalation.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: I would be stumbling in the dark without the intel from your informants and our Rhodes Island colleagues.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: But Millscar...

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Selling dangerous drugs of unknown origin, offering predatory loans, threatening the lives of the citizenry... and colluding with the Sarkaz...

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: All the evidence lies in my drawer, all of it corroborated. She cannot be allowed to run unchecked just because some few benefited from association with her.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Allerdale, she—

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: It's not just her, Delphine.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: No one wants to see this hard-earned peace broken again, after all we've been through.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Parliament promised safety to the people. I know what must be done.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Very well. An old friend has a lead on her that might interest you.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: By the way, I've given serious consideration to the Doctor's suggestion.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Once things have settled down for a bit, I'll return to Windermere and take back certain things that have always belonged to me.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: How long will you be?

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: I don't know. But the Doctor is right. I need what Mother left behind, if I am to help you... even if I was reluctant at the time of her death.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: It's for myself, too. Victoria, Windermere, Lynncardine... I must see for myself that which Mother cared so much about.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: It's the only way I can get closer to her.

steps.name: Injured Exemplar
steps.text: Sir! Please allow me to still call you that... I-I didn't think you would come to me.

steps.name: Injured Exemplar
steps.text: Did my application go through?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Walker, I've heard how Pitt and the others got you to leave the scene of the protest. I think—

steps.name: Walker
steps.text: So that's not what you're here for... Alright. Actually, I've been listening to the radio, sir.

steps.name: Walker
steps.text: I heard about the artillery handover to the newly reorganized Defense Forces under your command, and the newly-constructed training plate outside the city.

steps.name: Walker
steps.text: I went to see it myself. The facilities are superb. I can even imagine myself training there...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I'm sorry, Walker, but I can't approve your application to join the Defense Forces.

steps.name: Walker
steps.text: Sure, if I'm not up to standard, I'll redouble my—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You know your own health. Training and fighting will only make it worse.

steps.name: Walker
steps.text: My condition is under control. I'm taking medicine. I haven't felt any pain from the rocks for a while! I'm getting better—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Millscar's medicine, right? We've analyzed it, and it's...

steps.name: Walker
steps.text: Nothing more than a painkiller. I know.

steps.name: Walker
steps.text: But that's what we need. Parliament's medicine rations are running out, aren't they?

steps.name: Walker
steps.text: At least this makes me feel better, for a while, and lets me practice wielding a crossbow with one hand. I'll pass the Defense Forces tests, sir.

steps.name: Walker
steps.text: 'There will be hope as long as we make it back home, no matter how bloody goddamned hard life is.' That's what you told me during the defense of Chetleigh.

a.text: 'We are the Exemplars.'
'We make miracles.'
What about life after the miracle, then? Where do the Exemplars go?

spans.text: What about life after the miracle, then? Where do the Exemplars go?

a.text: Horn said the miracle of the previous Exemplars lived on in Gaul, in the textbooks of military schools. What about us? It was a question no one needed to think about before we truly returned to Londinium.

spans.text: Horn said the miracle of the previous Exemplars lived on in Gaul, in the textbooks of military schools. What about us? It was a question no one needed to think about before we truly returned to Londinium.

a.text: When the city broadcast announced that the city belonged to the Victorians again, the youngest girl in my group asked me,

spans.text: When the city broadcast announced that the city belonged to the Victorians again, the youngest girl in my group asked me,

a.text: 'Where do we go from here?'
I said we go home; I'll go back to the Slobberknocker with Hannah, Vina and Dagda, and you get to go home too.

spans.text: I said we go home; I'll go back to the Slobberknocker with Hannah, Vina and Dagda, and you get to go home too.

a.text: But the girl told me...
'I don't have a home anymore. I only have you.'

spans.text: 'I don't have a home anymore. I only have you.'

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Vina and the others are here. We ought to go down.

steps.name: Walker
steps.text: Vina? Speaker Vina? She's coming for me too? Because of the protest?

steps.name: Walker
steps.text: Did you come to keep an eye on me, sir?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: She came to help you because she knew Vina was coming. Same for all of us.
There is no warmth in Londinium's sunset.
The survivors do not remember if it has always been this way. Those who come after will not even question it.
Once, The Shard was the pride of this old nomadic city. Now, people pay careful attention not to step into its shadow.
They all remember the day that terror itself descended upon its pinnacle, beneath the burning red sky.
Two walk side-by-side through the sparse crowd, the setting sun drawing long shadows behind them.
Those they pass bow to them, then go back to the work at hand, humming—
♪Then may we call and savely syng,
♪Victoria, yeve thankes for owre hom!

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: The refurbishment of The Shard seems to be proceeding ahead of schedule.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Rhodes Island helped a lot: providing medicine, taking in patients, and the Engineering Department has been helping with construction work in the city.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: The initial incident left such an impression on the people that the proposal to modify The Shard met no significant opposition.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: And we're cleaning up the Originium crystal growths in the city while we're at it.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: But the engineers of the Self-Salvation Corps say it'll take some time for things to go back to normal. Even the mobility layer is affected.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Have we confirmed the retrieval team for The Shard's core technologies?

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: We have a preliminary list, but we're still doing background checks on some of the technicians and scholars. They have... certain links, if you know what I mean.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: I do. The dukes have given me a heads-up. We'll turn a blind eye, as long as there's no serious issue.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: I, for one, am hoping that they find something worthwhile in that scrapheap. It would be a good thing for Victoria.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: And it's not such a bad thing for us if they started fighting over it.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Vina. Delphine.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Horn? I thought you were...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I came to visit an old comrade.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Don't mind me. I was just about to go and see how Bagpipe's doing with the new recruits.
Horn stretches, but shows no sign of leaving. Vina sighs.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Vina! You would never guess what Walker and I talked about. You remember the Davises, who came with us from Chetleigh? Well, the wife just gave birth—

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: I know why you're here, Morgan.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Walker and the protests are a matter for Parliament... it's not something I should get involved in.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: I'm just here to talk about the whereabouts of Millscar.

steps.name: Walker
steps.text: Thanks, but there's no need to make things difficult for Madam Speaker.

steps.name: Walker
steps.text: I trust Parliament. I know many MPs. Fine people.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Parliament is not as simple as you think. There are those who would prefer to escalate the issue.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: But resolving the Millscar issue as soon as possible is in the best interests of everyone, including you.

a.text: The solder who charged into the city with us stood in the setting sun, suffering our 'interrogation'.

spans.text: The solder who charged into the city with us stood in the setting sun, suffering our 'interrogation'.

a.text: We all know that Vina can influence Parliament... if she chooses to.

spans.text: We all know that Vina can influence Parliament... if she chooses to.

a.text: That was the day when I truly realized that Vina had not belonged solely to the Glasgow Gang for a long time.

spans.text: That was the day when I truly realized that Vina had not belonged solely to the Glasgow Gang for a long time.

a.text: Maybe my Vina already said goodbye to us that afternoon.

spans.text: Maybe my Vina already said goodbye to us that afternoon.

a.text: That day, all factories of the city came rumbling to life, and steam gushed up to the sky.

spans.text: That day, all factories of the city came rumbling to life, and steam gushed up to the sky.

a.text: I saw her golden hair flying wild in the wind, blocking the fleeting tears in her eyes. She turned towards us with a smile and said—

spans.text: I saw her golden hair flying wild in the wind, blocking the fleeting tears in her eyes. She turned towards us with a smile and said—

a.text: 'We're home.'
We're home. But things have not gone the way we expected.

spans.text: We're home. But things have not gone the way we expected.

a.text: Does going back home mean goodbye?

spans.text: Does going back home mean goodbye?

a.text: Will we lose Vina?
'The factories welcome us!'
'There are survivors in the city!'
'Why do you stand in our way?'
'I'm sorry... dukes' orders. The Exemplars must not act on their own until the dukes have come to a conclusion.'
'Why are you pointing your bow at me?'
'Weren't we fighting side-by-side just a moment ago?'
'What do we do? Is that a... protest? In the city?'

steps.text: The city was angry.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: The troops that stood in our way... are they falling back?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: The factories are waking up? I thought the Sarkaz had shut everything down.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: ...I remember these factories. I know where they are. I always will.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: That's Miles Industries on York Street! And that's Coppola Foods on Scott Street! And that's—

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: 'Consolidated Inc.'... 'Hankin's'... 'South Wicker Cargo'...

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: (Choked) Vina... I thought they...
Those that were silent, those that had been abandoned, those that had been commandeered by the Sarkaz, and those that continued to run timidly.
All the city's factories came alive at the same time, but the Sarkaz hastily pulling back from the battlefield outside the city had no time to notice.
The steam that gushed out was the breath of steel and machine. The factories were roaring.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: What's going on?

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: They're helping us. Londinium is helping us.

steps.name: Allied Soldier
steps.text: March on, Exemplars. It's time to bring this to an end.

steps.name: Allied Soldier
steps.text: This is Lieutenant Diane Weber of the Sixth Column, Tenth Infantry Regiment. Lower your weapons, soldiers, and escort the Exemplars in their advance.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: You're defying the dukes?

steps.name: Diane
steps.text: Before I was a soldier, I was a Londinier. This is my home too.

steps.name: Diane
steps.text: Go, Siege. The fight is not yet over.

steps.name: Diane
steps.text: We will take back what is ours!
The first squad starts lowering their crossbows, and they are soon followed by others, who step aside to clear a path.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Exemplars, forward!

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: We're home.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Keep the factories running at full steam! Keep the Sarkaz at bay just a bit longer!

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: The dukes want people to think there's no Victorians left alive, justifying them sitting on their hands out there. But we'll make 'em hear we're still here!

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: The people outside the walls will know we haven't given up yet!

steps.name: Percival
steps.text: Thanks for the assist, Madam Catherine. You can trust our guys; everyone has a trick or two up their sleeves.

steps.name: Percival
steps.text: Nine and the others are working on the other factories. This whole city is about to rise up.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Are you coming back... Feist?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Is it on?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: On it is! The other factories have also been restored, just as the Doctor planned.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: It's not just the citizens that are helping us though. There are other people, and they call themselves—

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Reunion...

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: Well, well. I haven't seen the city so lively in years.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: I just got word that alliance troops have cleared a path for the Exemplars.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: That wasn't our orders. Are you happy with the test results?

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: It seems we have underestimated the influence of a miracle.

steps.name: Duke of Caster
steps.text: We should hasten our preparations, then.

steps.name: Mysterious Mercenary
steps.text: Hey, boss, looks like we don't have to cause a commotion anymore.

steps.name: Mysterious Mercenary
steps.text: They're letting the Exemplars through.
Pull the ambush and give a hand to the factories we captured.
Tell the people in charge that the boilers keep burning until I say stop.

steps.name: Mysterious Mercenary
steps.text: You got it.
Welcome home, Vina.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Speaker's Office.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Walker's fine. Parliament won't come down hard on him over this little thing. But tell him to stay safe.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: There's no telling if the people watching us might find him inconvenient to them.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: And... how are things going over there?

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: ...Good.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: We'll find you...

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Allerdale.
